theme: An open day — clear the Adriatic bookings while the calendar's quiet.
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — no meetings, just the St. Pete stay running in the background. The real pull is the September Croatia trip: three bookings that each close a gap, two of them due today.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on both Eurowings Discover legs. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's site and buy bags online now — two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on, and counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Book the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the kids aren't picked up until Sept 22 — the nights of Sept 20–21 in St. Pete are still unbooked. Also glance at whether the Sept 27 Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: One night on Sept 19 in Cavtat near the airport, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30am Sept 20 flight. It's the only unbooked night on the Croatia leg, and it was due Aug 23.

inbox.noise: Four unread, all promotional or account-notice noise — nothing awaiting a reply.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: High summer wants something light and quick — salmon in foil keeps the kitchen cool and lets the season's produce sit alongside.

acts.line: No meetings on the books — the open stretch is best spent on the three Croatia bookings before anything else fills it.
Clear through the afternoon, with the Kenwood stay in St. Pete running quietly in the background.
The evening's yours and the kids are home — an early dinner and the wind-down routine.
